semantically_equivalent_models.justification: The term 'neural network ensemble' refers to a combination of multiple neural network models to improve performance. 'Ensemble of multitask multilayer perceptrons' describes a similar concept where multiple models are used together in an ensemble. Even though the exact architecture or multitasking aspect might slightly differ, they are semantically equivalent in the context of using a combination of networks.
